state:Andhra Pradesh.text: The Andhra Pradesh government has pursued extensive artificial intelligence initiatives focused on infrastructure development, education, and public service delivery. Major actions include partnering with technology giants such as Google and Reliance to establish multibillion-dollar hyperscale AI data centers and hubs in Visakhapatnam and Amaravati [R42588509, R1349768b, R37f1fbdf]. The state has also integrated AI across various governance sectors, deploying applications for urban flood forecasting, tax administration, healthcare delivery, and police monitoring [Rd4cc8595, R6e71a6d9, R84d949ed, R1e515ffc]. Additionally, Andhra Pradesh has advanced workforce readiness and education by introducing compulsory AI training for teachers, partnering with firms like IBM and Microsoft for youth skill development, and planning dedicated frontier technology universities [R06697b72, R9fe15d9b, R5237da05, Re98842fe].

state:Bihar.text: The Government of Bihar has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, education, and public services, highlighted by major partnerships finalized at events like the AI Impact Summit and the launch of the Bihar AI Mission [R44971ae6, Rb70e845b]. State authorities have partnered with technology firms such as Google and Microsoft to train government schoolteachers in AI tools, introduce AI into school classrooms, and procure software licenses [Reb7bfdb3, R1b5b6306, R3beb3201]. Furthermore, AI applications have been deployed for administrative and public infrastructure tasks, including e-cabinet systems, public distribution system monitoring, police patrolling, and healthcare services [Re986d143, Rac954476, R79af63e1, R79e87d3a].

state:Gujarat.text: Gujarat has heavily invested in artificial intelligence infrastructure, policy frameworks, and governance applications, establishing specialized initiatives like data centre policies targeting Green AI capacity alongside GPU-as-a-Service and sovereign park proposals [Re041bd74, R43f4ae2b, Rd1b68bba, Rb40e306d]. The state government has integrated AI across various sectors, ranging from agricultural and educational platforms to police surveillance hackathons and crime tracking tools [Ra310e3fc, R88fee491, R28ccc09b, Rd78856c5]. Meanwhile, institutional bodies like the Gujarat High Court have engaged with the technology by enacting policies that prohibit AI use in judicial decision-making while addressing challenges related to AI-generated citations [Rbd9766bd, R3cc78d30].

state:Karnataka.text: Karnataka has pursued extensive AI integration across governance, public services, and infrastructure through partnerships with major technology entities like Anthropic and ElevenLabs [R65d60606, Rff273deb]. The state is establishing multiple Centres of Excellence, approving regional AI hubs, and advancing large-scale physical projects such as the Bidadi AI Township and the proposed Artificial Intelligence University [Re78dfed2, Rb7265c49, R2c8e9508, Rb77b1a7f]. Educational reforms feature prominently, including early tech and AI training starting from Class 6 in government schools, vocational courses, and teacher skilling initiatives [R8176ca19, R3e7508f6, R044b5fa1]. Furthermore, administrative processes utilize AI tools for tasks ranging from staff attendance and crop surveys to citizen service delivery and language translation [Rf518fff6, Ra61ec765, R9d27904f].

state:Maharashtra.text: Maharashtra has actively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem by approving a comprehensive AI policy backed by a ₹10,000 crore planned investment, establishing a dedicated IT and AI department, and deploying governance and oversight committees [R562864e1, Rd7d40f74, Rbff13ca0, R5afedf9c]. The state government has integrated AI across numerous public sectors, implementing initiatives such as the Maha AI and MahaINDUS governance platforms, police cybercrime copilots, and multilingual tools in partnership with tech entities like Microsoft, Google, and Sarvam AI [R04592b70, R68fee1a0, R7ec03dda, R03b6b6d6]. Furthermore, Maharashtra has driven large-scale infrastructure and educational projects, including massive data centre investments, mandatory teacher training, and specialized agricultural and safety programs [Re0b416d1, R2889d124, Rcd594eaf, Radc0ac36].

state:Odisha.text: Odisha is actively integrating artificial intelligence across public administration, infrastructure, and education through policy initiatives and high-value partnerships [Rc729937b, R7b1537aa]. The state has driven major technological investments, including large-scale AI data center agreements with companies like HCLTech and proposed sovereign compute projects with partners such as Sarvam AI [R31b27cb7, R230b6e3b, R3a36bb44]. Public service delivery has also expanded via AI-powered WhatsApp chatbots like 'Ama Sathi' and sector-specific tools for agriculture, traffic enforcement, and wildlife protection [Rabdf8555, Re1a077a6, R8a2dd09f, R499f4234]. Furthermore, the government has prioritized AI skill development by incorporating emerging technology courses into higher education curricula and establishing specialized training hubs [Rdb5da3c5, Re8e598e1, Re8e598e1].

state:Punjab.text: Punjab has pursued extensive artificial intelligence integration across education, governance, agriculture, and law enforcement. The state school education board introduced AI into the computer science curriculum and public school system for classes across various grade levels [Rf6319e99, R11fad9f5, Rf4a0d422]. In policing and public safety, the state partnered with IIT Ropar to establish an in-house AI laboratory and deployed smart technologies like voice recognition and automated tracking to combat organized crime [R7333c0ad, R132d8a77, R3ee3be90]. Additionally, Punjab advanced agricultural advisory services and healthcare diagnostics through AI-driven tools [Ree614b14, R609b6fc5].

state:Tamil Nadu.text: Tamil Nadu has significantly advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major infrastructure projects, including plans for an AI city, a Sovereign AI Park, and an AI data center established in partnership with IIT Madras [R1b6cbab3, R472c3c1a, R305828a2]. The state government has integrated AI into public service delivery and governance by deploying WhatsApp chatbots like 'Namma Arasu' and 'NalamAI' for hospital and administrative services, alongside AI systems for wildlife conservation and traffic safety [R576baa19, R494484b4, Rc2b44680, R7efcaa10]. Furthermore, educational and workforce initiatives have been prioritized, such as training government school teachers and students in AI tools, introducing AI/ML trades in industrial training institutes, and partnering with technology providers to foster deep-tech skills [R9cd35018, Rfe24cede, R5742a9b1, Rae27a6f6].

state:Telangana.text: Telangana has actively pursued artificial intelligence integration across infrastructure, governance, and education through strategic partnerships and institutional frameworks [Rd6f74125, R389847d5]. The state has attracted massive investments for AI data centers and cloud infrastructure, alongside plans for a dedicated AI City [R5b4a7a80, Ra0d04f11, Rfd882f23]. Government initiatives leverage AI for public services, including policing, traffic management, agricultural market transactions, and revenue collection [Ra1409382, Rce4536fa, R45e372bd, R849548ed]. Furthermore, the state has launched extensive skilling and literacy programs to train students and government employees in artificial intelligence [R6843cc3b, R89c590e8, R59295049].

state:Uttar Pradesh.text: The Uttar Pradesh government has actively pursued artificial intelligence integration through substantial infrastructure investments, including approved data center policies, an AI city initiative in Lucknow, and a robotics and AI park in Greater Noida [R398131aa, Rbcca7384, Rb1cbd4df]. Governance and administrative processes have seen widespread deployment of AI, featuring automated checks for pensions, traffic route management, judicial transcription tools, and exam surveillance systems [Rd1807ca7, R721729e0, R231ba3cf, R840f85d3]. Additionally, the state has launched workforce skilling initiatives such as the UP Artificial Intelligence Mission, mandatory vocational training courses, and partnerships with technology firms to train millions of youth [Rb312992b, R1e320eca, R10e7268a].

category:strategy_policy.text: State governments across India have increasingly focused on formalizing AI strategies, establishing dedicated policies, and approving major financial investments to build local tech ecosystems [R6a6bee70, R562864e1, Rc68da9b5]. Several states like Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and Rajasthan have rolled out dedicated AI missions or policies paired with infrastructure hubs, data centers, and targeted startup goals [R6a6bee70, R562864e1, R3cf60d9f, Rb312992b, Rc9c3c4c4]. Administrations are also heavily investing in educational reforms, skilling initiatives, and public sector governance overhauls to integrate artificial intelligence into public services and classrooms [R4af400f2, R8f4114ad, R2c0df2e5, R5c2eec42].

category:regulation_ethics.text: State governments and high courts have actively introduced regulatory frameworks and guidelines to address the ethical challenges, data privacy concerns, and risks associated with artificial intelligence. Notably, the high courts of Gujarat and Kerala, along with the Punjab and Haryana High Court, have restricted or prohibited the use of AI tools in judicial decision-making, judgment drafting, and issuing notices to preserve public trust and prevent reliance on non-existent case laws [Rbd9766bd, R12b7585e, R3cc78d30, R8eacd504, R3d477cff, Rd45f0fb4, Re909a24e]. Meanwhile, states like Karnataka, Rajasthan, Telangana, and Maharashtra have focused on responsible AI adoption by establishing ethics committees, drafting data governance frameworks, and issuing restrictive circulars to protect confidential taxpayer and student data from unauthorized platforms [R9b3c768e, R607d069a, R3f7241e3, Ra75d01a2, Rdff5f567, R680564f5]. Additionally, several administrations have targeted synthetic media misuse, implementing mandatory labeling for AI-generated content, tackling deepfake scams, and addressing digital safety concerns for students and citizens [Raf4f7b8d, R7c216cfc, R783d943c, Rf972ff43].

category:funding_budget.text: Indian state governments have launched substantial financial commitments and funding mechanisms to drive artificial intelligence infrastructure, data centers, and specialized missions. Notable initiatives include multi-year state missions and large-scale infrastructure investments, such as Chhattisgarh's Rs 500 crore AI Mission and Uttar Pradesh's multi-crore AI and skill development programs [R7cc53f61, Rb312992b, R297b1b1d]. States are also attracting massive private capital and international partnerships for high-capacity data centers and sovereign compute projects, ranging from large agreements in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh to major proposals in Maharashtra and Bihar [Rd3f465ac, R3eefbde9, R00b3c6a6, R3a36bb44]. Additionally, funds are being directed toward sector-specific applications such as agriculture, wildlife protection, and workforce skilling to integrate AI across public governance and higher education [R68fee1a0, Radc0ac36, R5c8784f8, R311c8976].

category:infrastructure.text: Indian state governments are aggressively scaling up AI infrastructure through massive investments in hyperscale data centers, green energy campuses, and specialized compute hubs [R31b27cb7, R5b4a7a80, R42588509]. States like Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Odisha have approved multibillion-dollar projects and policy frameworks—such as Uttar Pradesh's Data Centre Policy 2026 and Gujarat's Data Centre Policy 2026-29—to attract global tech giants and accelerate local compute capacities [R398131aa, Re041bd74, R657bba09]. Additionally, regional administrations are building dedicated AI cities, sovereign parks, and innovation hubs to bolster deep-tech ecosystems, research, and public sector adoption [R1b6cbab3, R472c3c1a, Re78dfed2, Rf4058825].

category:partnership.text: Indian state governments have actively pursued partnerships and Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with major technology firms, academic institutions, and industry leaders to build artificial intelligence infrastructure, data centers, and skilling programs. States like Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Gujarat, Karnataka, Maharashtra, and Telangana have secured massive investments for hyperscale AI data centers, specialized compute hubs, and Centres of Excellence [R42588509, R44971ae6, Reff5d158, Re0b416d1, R998e03d5]. Additionally, several states have engaged companies such as Google, Microsoft, and ElevenLabs to modernize education, train government teachers in AI literacy, deploy voice-powered citizen services, and improve public governance and healthcare delivery [Reb7bfdb3, R2889d124, Rff273deb, R6473839f]. These collaborative initiatives reflect a widespread regional push to expand localized digital economies, foster startup ecosystems, and integrate artificial intelligence across public administration and education [R65d2a417, R65d60606].

category:deployment.text: Indian state governments are actively deploying artificial intelligence across diverse sectors such as governance, public service delivery, education, and health. Major initiatives include the implementation of AI-powered chatbots and messaging tools for citizen services, as well as specialized platforms for administrative workflows, tax administration, and police investigations [Rabdf8555, R04592b70, R6e71a6d9]. States have also integrated AI into public safety, traffic management, and educational programs through tools like computer vision, automated surveillance, and AI-driven learning tools [R27258895, Re7e20a6f, R840f85d3].

category:skilling.text: Indian state governments have aggressively expanded artificial intelligence (AI) skilling initiatives, focusing heavily on integrating AI education into school curricula and training teachers. States like Punjab and Karnataka have introduced AI into school classes, with Punjab becoming the first state to launch AI as a mainstream subject for Classes I to XII and Karnataka planning early tech training starting from Class 6 [Rf6319e99, R8176ca19]. Numerous states have established partnerships with major technology firms and institutions like Google, Microsoft, and IITs to facilitate capacity building, digital learning spaces, and teacher training programs [Reb7bfdb3, R49bc3f02, R1b5b6306, R3bfd0d73]. Furthermore, ambitious state missions—such as those in Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and Gujarat—aim to train hundreds of thousands of youth and government school educators in emerging digital technologies and AI applications [Rb312992b, Ra6932da2, R1a841461].

category:events_outreach.text: State governments across India have actively driven AI adoption and digital governance through a wide array of summits, conferences, and boot camps. Major regional and national events—such as the India AI Impact Summit, Bengaluru Tech Summit, and various regional AI impact conferences—served as platforms for states like Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Odisha, and Uttar Pradesh to sign deals, showcase innovations, and plan future workforce strategies [R84a7e58c, Rec3b838b, R4348031c, R4d3bfbb9]. Additionally, states have focused heavily on student and youth engagement via targeted hackathons, skill initiatives, and workshops, including police surveillance hackathons in Gujarat, AI skill initiatives for school students in Tripura, and youth conclaves in Madhya Pradesh [R3fff65a8, R28ccc09b, Re9890866]. Workshops on specialized applications like multilingual AI via BHASHINI and digital governance further highlighted state efforts to integrate artificial intelligence into public services and regional development [Rfe753238, R8e91e0e8, R28219609].

state:Kerala.text: Kerala has advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, education, law enforcement, and infrastructure development. The state government rebranded its IT department to focus on AI and future technologies, established twin AI Centres of Excellence, and attracted major investments such as a large AI-driven data centre [Rcaa18758, Ref58a154, Ra525c46d]. In the public sector and judiciary, authorities integrated AI-assisted administrative overhauls, translation and transcription tools, and traffic monitoring systems alongside robotics and cyber safety protocols [Rf2c35456, R8f4114ad, Raf4f7b8d, R70b2d101]. Educational programs have also seen widespread AI integration, ranging from specialized school training and robotics mandates to generative AI tools for students and teachers [R0689eb15, R3db21292, Rb2b9a51b, Rc3656b09].

category:governance_body.text: Several Indian states have established specialized governance bodies, ministries, and administrative departments to drive artificial intelligence integration across public administration [R2dd69e13, R6f0677ec]. Pioneering states like Kerala and Tamil Nadu have appointed dedicated ministers and rebranded IT departments to focus on AI and future technologies [Ref58a154, R1b255da2]. Additionally, states including Maharashtra, Karnataka, Gujarat, and Bihar have formed targeted AI task forces, committees, and advisory panels to oversee policy implementation, ethical frameworks, and administrative reforms [R9b3c768e, Rfb71877d, Rdc0edc3a, R301d6af1]. Law enforcement agencies in states like West Bengal, Haryana, Jharkhand, and Telangana have also created specialized AI cells and units to modernize policing and data analysis [Ra1409382, Re268e526, Ra6b5d331, R25c27df1].

overall.text: Indian state governments have widely pursued artificial intelligence initiatives focusing on infrastructure, governance, and educational integration across multiple regions [R31b27cb7, Rf6319e99, R127f881c]. Several states have approved dedicated artificial intelligence policies, established high-capacity data centre campuses, and introduced specialized regional hubs and missions to attract major technology investments [R6a6bee70, R5b4a7a80, R472c3c1a]. At the same time, regional authorities are deploying artificial intelligence tools to improve public service delivery, police investigations, judicial frameworks, and school curriculums [Rd731fc75, Rbd9766bd, R27258895].

state:Assam.text: Assam has pursued an extensive AI-driven transformation across governance, education, healthcare, and infrastructure, marked by the rollout of foundational AI roadmaps and state data capabilities [R936eb0aa, R4203359c, R416e5d33]. The state has integrated artificial intelligence into public services and disaster management, introducing tools such as the WhatsApp-based 'Jal Raksha' flood relief platform, satellite and AI forest monitoring, and AI-powered administrative systems [Rc2490b65, R9c52da90, Rdc7ff729]. Educational and workforce initiatives feature partnerships with Google and UNICEF to train teachers, deploy AI attendance systems, and establish dedicated centres of excellence [R8b7a258f, Red858166, R39b50ddb, R9c3a4d8c]. Furthermore, Assam has applied AI solutions to wildlife conservation, security, and healthcare upgrades, while addressing emerging challenges through digital voice preservation and deepfake regulations [R037e76ac, Ra093ebca, Rdc188dd0, Rf195e841].

state:Chhattisgarh.text: Chhattisgarh has advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives through the approval of a Rs 500 crore AI Mission over five years, focusing on digital economy, governance, and skill development [R7cc53f61]. The state has also concentrated on infrastructure investments, including foundations for AI data center parks and special economic zones in Nava Raipur [Rcc6c8e84, Rd28b546d]. In the education sector, the government partnered with Google India to launch an AI education campaign aimed at training over 2 lakh teachers and integrating technology into tribal and rural schools [R398fad0d, Rf7c7fd70]. Furthermore, public services have integrated AI applications across domains, ranging from wildlife conservation and police investigations to road monitoring and automated alert systems [R96ea213d, Reb028d74, Re3198684, R6c86e7f3].

state:Haryana.text: Haryana has advanced its technology-driven governance framework through major initiatives such as the Haryana AI Development Project and plans for an AI data centre and sandbox environments [R127f881c, R56704031, R03b25e4d]. The state government is integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including a police modernization plan focused on cybercrime tracking, drone-driven surveillance models, and AI-backed tools for tuberculosis screening and agriculture [Ra6b5d331, Rdb9464b3, Rf90e65a4, R8677362d]. Additionally, educational reforms are introducing AI and vocational subjects into schools, Industrial Training Institutes, and upcoming digital colleges in Gurugram and Panchkula [Rcd5e27a7, Rf9aabd25, Rb029010f].

state:Himachal Pradesh.text: Himachal Pradesh has actively integrated artificial intelligence across education, governance, and public services, including the launch of digital learning tools like the 'Padhai with AI' app in Bilaspur and the incorporation of AI curricula in schools [Rb23a865a, Rbc10366f]. The state government has advanced AI-driven administrative systems, such as document verification on the Him Seva Portal and meeting management platforms, alongside healthcare initiatives like robotic-assisted surgeries and AI fraud-detection in the Himcare scheme [R38e56e62, R1ba6a5ba, Rc3a3d3b4, Reb98bbcd]. Furthermore, institutional collaborations with bodies like IIT Mandi have driven projects in forest intelligence, ecological restoration, disaster resilience, and deepfake detection [Rd81af6f6, Re6fc0429, R26835c79, Rc06b19cc].

state:Jharkhand.text: Jharkhand has advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, healthcare, education, and infrastructure, anchored by the launch of the Jharkhand AI Policy 2026 and the Jharkhand AI Vision-2050 roadmap [R4b4e0b34, R927ec078]. The state government has integrated AI into public administration and public safety, utilizing AI-based cameras, drones, and surveillance systems for crowd monitoring during events and wildlife tracking to mitigate human-animal conflicts [R96eaad17, R558f4a5f, R118b938d]. Furthermore, healthcare and education sectors are seeing substantial modernization, including digital health conclaves, AI-powered learning platforms in schools, and new AI training programs for officials and students [Rd25878d1, Rfd41fa83, R36a0ee65, Rb74fac99].

state:Madhya Pradesh.text: Madhya Pradesh is actively integrating artificial intelligence across public administration, infrastructure development, and economic planning under Chief Minister Mohan Yadav's leadership. Key initiatives include partnering with Google Cloud for AI-driven governance, attracting major investments for AI-ready data centers and chip packaging facilities, and deploying AI surveillance for crowd management during the Simhastha 2028 preparations [R12d4ab71, R6473839f, Rac12a0cd, R4df0843d]. Additionally, the state has applied AI to real-time forest and environmental monitoring, public transport optimization, and civic procurement auditing [Rc8beb73d, R7c96135c, R4c96f220].

state:Manipur.text: Manipur has advanced its digital governance and artificial intelligence adoption through strategic partnerships and sector-specific applications, including a collaboration with Microsoft and a multilingual AI MoU with the Digital India BHASHINI Division [R8e91e0e8, Rad868781, Rdc31ca32]. The state has integrated AI across multiple domains, such as launching translation applications like 'Ishaan', exploring AI to curb wildlife trafficking, and applying technology to tribal development and tourism [R7249ca9d, R49d826c3, R3413274d, Re9f95033]. Furthermore, academic institutions and the judiciary have embraced these innovations, highlighted by research workshops at Manipur University and the Manipur High Court utilizing AI for legal research [R546f135d, R647a600d].

state:Meghalaya.text: Meghalaya is actively integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including governance, education, agriculture, and public health, positioning itself as a leader in tech-driven development [Radc3741c, Rf1f88f85, R84a1eeb7]. Significant actions include drafting a new IT policy focused on AI and global capability centres, proposing a Rs 20 crore AI Centre of Excellence at Shillong Technology Park Phase II, and introducing AI-enabled learning initiatives in schools [R9625f972, Rf277c3a3, R24be49c9]. Additionally, the state has leveraged data-driven governance to improve public health metrics, deployed AI solutions for environmental and waste management, and hosted the Regional Artificial Intelligence Impact Conference [Rac5495f0, Rd7994ab1, R84a1eeb7].

state:Tripura.text: Tripura is actively advancing artificial intelligence integration across multiple sectors, aiming to launch a state-level AI policy and partnering with Google India and IIT Kharagpur to build a robust technological ecosystem [Rc68da9b5, R33168f25, R9435f1d2]. The state has introduced several educational initiatives, including free AI courses for school students, robotics and VR labs, and an AI-powered school monitoring system [R3fff65a8, R12023632, R311a6da8, R20047d48]. Furthermore, the government is deploying AI to enhance public services, governance, healthcare diagnostics, and law enforcement traffic and security management [R8edb04a8, R2235629e, Rbf61a3aa, Rdc265ce0].

state:Uttarakhand.text: Uttarakhand has actively advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, education, and environmental management, highlighted by events like the Devbhoomi AI Summit and various digital empowerment meetings [R8a719696, R042443f1]. The state has integrated AI into public services and safety, implementing AI agents for cyber fraud helplines, face recognition for the Chardham Yatra, and AI-driven systems to monitor tax evasion and forest encroachment [R549f779d, R9dac4ef2, Recb1f69d, Rbdd4d909]. Educational reforms include mandating AI coursework across universities, launching 'AI-for-All' programs with institutions like IIT Madras, and establishing AI facilities and labs [R42cd5368, R1742b1a0, Rcea6d545]. Additionally, conservation efforts leverage AI through acoustic surveillance in forests, wildlife monitoring, and intrusion detection systems to protect wildlife and mitigate human-animal conflicts [R994e0e10, R82962675, R0056f175].

state:West Bengal.text: West Bengal is actively integrating artificial intelligence across economic, educational, and governance domains to drive industrial revival and modernization [R2434d991, R1ada3e48]. The state's industrial strategy features initiatives such as the West Bengal AI Mission, a draft industrial policy focusing on data centers and AI, and the accelerated Silicon Valley project [Rf93d2652, R0c1ea7de, R90ad9af5]. In education, the state has introduced AI, data science, and coding curricula across schools and higher secondary boards, alongside workforce training partnerships with entities like Oracle [Rac4428c1, Rf61a82a3, R6da26467, R0c4d9eef]. Additionally, law enforcement and public administration are utilizing AI through dedicated police cells, investigation apps like Samarth, and AI-powered public helplines [Re268e526, R904a08ab, R08e415eb].

state:Rajasthan.text: The government of Rajasthan has actively integrated artificial intelligence across numerous public sectors, highlighted by the approval of the AI-ML Policy 2026 and the unveiling of specialized technology policies to attract investment [R6a6bee70, R250bc457]. Key administrative actions include deploying AI for agricultural partnerships, wildlife and water conservation, modernized policing, and traffic management [R6de84b70, R311c8976, Rd7e6b721, R0af96cb6]. Additionally, the state has adopted AI tools to enhance public grievance redressal through the Rajasthan Sampark platform and introduced digital governance initiatives alongside educational updates [Rcaf01e51, Rf789607f].

state:Nagaland.text: Nagaland has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, public administration, and specialized sectors such as disaster preparedness, agriculture, law enforcement, and animal production [Ra8c17a13, R3a286812, R17676278, Rbf1aee2c]. Significant initiatives include launching an AI supercomputer, an AI-powered digital agriculture ecosystem, police surveillance cameras, and award-winning WhatsApp chatbots to improve public services and skill development access [Ra8c17a13, R3a286812, R1ee21379, R17676278, Rb26a6b87]. The state has also prioritized education and capacity building through the inauguration of an AI Centre of Excellence for Skilling, faculty development workshops, and plans to introduce an AI curriculum in schools starting from Class 6 [R6f55ee54, Rb7d1d850, R8b9ea930, Ree819f7b].

state:Sikkim.text: Sikkim has actively integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, most notably deploying an AI-driven Traffic Management System and e-challan mechanisms to enhance road safety and manage traffic congestion [Re7e20a6f, R24fc93a2, Ref56657c]. In education and agriculture, the state has launched AI-powered learning programs in government schools, partnered with NIELIT Gangtok to establish an AI Centre of Excellence, and pilot-tested an AI-enabled WhatsApp chatbot to support farmers [R27258895, Red4520ff, R2569fc2d]. Additionally, the government has advanced technology adoption by introducing an AI-based permit system to boost tourism and discussing AI applications for disaster prediction and higher education partnerships [Rfc6c0173, Rb685bb8f, R604d927c].
